description: Report that the live world disagrees with the map — a closed road, a wrong or missing restriction, a bad speed limit, a missing road, a wrong one-way, or changed access. Use it when you observe the mismatch mid-task. Provide `location` {lat, lon}, a `category` (road_closed, wrong_restriction, wrong_speed_limit, missing_road, wrong_oneway, access_changed, other) and optionally a `description`, the OSM `way_id` and an `evidence_url`. This is a first-party observation: it is QUEUED for human/agent review and NEVER changes routing immediately or edits any map. Returns the queued report_id.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

MapIssueCategory.description:
The kind of map/live-world mismatch an agent is reporting.

A first-party *observation* only: it records what the agent saw on the
ground, never an edit to any map or OSM-derived database.

oneOf.description: A road the map shows as open is closed (roadworks, collapse, event).
A turn/access/dimension/weight restriction is wrong or missing.
The posted speed limit differs from the map's value.
A road exists on the ground but is absent from the map.
A one-way direction is wrong (or the road is not one-way at all).
Access has changed (e.g. now gated, private, or newly public).
Anything else that does not fit the categories above.

category.description: What kind of mismatch this is.

description.description:
Free-text detail of what was observed on the ground, e.g. "barrier
across the lane, diversion signed via the B4009". Bounded length.

evidence_url.description:
A URL backing the observation (photo, notice, news item), when one
exists. Bounded length.

location.description: Where the mismatch was observed (WGS84 decimal degrees).

way_id.description:
The OSM way id the observation concerns, when the caller knows it.
Optional — the report stands on its own as a first-party
observation and is never tied to OSM data beyond this hint.

name: report_map_issue

category.description: The category, echoed back as its snake_case wire tag.

report_id.description: The generated id of the queued report (cite it in follow-ups).

status.description:
Always "queued": the report awaits human/agent review and changes
nothing about routing immediately.
